# Test generation guidance

The curated installation places skills under `.agents/skills`, rather than
beside `.github/agents`. Read and follow the
[canonical test-generation prompt](../../../.agents/skills/code-testing/unit-test-generation.prompt.md).

## Report-safe test names and result validation

Read and apply the
[canonical report-safety contract](../../../.agents/skills/code-testing/unit-test-generation.prompt.md#report-safe-test-names-and-result-validation)
before generating tests or reporting results.
